name: What preparations do I need to make before my trim replacement project begins?

mainEntity.name: What preparations do I need to make before my trim replacement project begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your trim replacement project starts, you can take a few preparatory steps. For exterior work, ensure clear access to all work areas by moving vehicles, patio furniture, and potted plants away from the house. For interior projects, clear furniture and decor away from walls where trim will be replaced. Protect floors and nearby items with drop cloths if painting or significant sanding is expected. Discuss with your contractor if they require access to electrical outlets or water. This preparation helps the crew work efficiently and reduces potential delays, ensuring process clarity for both parties.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear access to work areas, move furniture, protect nearby items, and confirm utility access with your contractor.
